input_messages.content: Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation, please.
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

I’d like to change my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight that departs the next day instead of my current date. Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO back by one day as well. 

For both flights, I only want options that depart after 8am and before 9pm.
Yes, those options work for me! Please go ahead and make those changes.

Thank you! Actually, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know how much that would cost? I’m willing to pay up to $200 for the upgrade and bags. If it’s more than that, I’m okay with keeping economy for the return flight.

Yes, please go ahead and upgrade just the outgoing flight to business class and keep the return in economy. I’d still like to have 2 checked bags for both flights. You can use my original payment method for the upgrade. Thank you!

I’d like to use the original form of payment that was used for the reservation—if that’s possible. If not, I’m okay with using the $338 gift card for the upgrade. Please let me know if either of those options will work.

Yes, please proceed with those updates—upgrade the outgoing flight to business class using the $338 gift card, keep the return in economy, and add 2 checked bags for both flights. That sounds perfect, thank you!
If that’s the case, I’ll just keep both flights in economy. I still want to add 2 checked bags for each flight, though. Please go ahead with that.
Yes, please go ahead and update my reservation to include 2 checked bags for both flights. Thank you for your help!

That’s great, thank you so much for your help! I’m all set now. Have a wonderful day! 

###STOP###
